standard.summary: TurboCore 是 Lulynx 训练器的性能优化引擎，集成多种 CUDA kernel 级别的加速：fused backward、native update dispatch、kernel autotune 等。
standard.effect: fused_backward：将多个 backward kernel 合并，减少 kernel 发射开销约 15%~20%（来自梯度释放管理器）；kernel_autotune：自动调优 CUDA kernel 参数（实测 1.14× 加速）；native_update_dispatch：优化权重更新路径。
standard.whenToUse: 所有 TurboCore 组件默认 off（实验性）。逐步开启验证稳定性后再开启更多组件。fused_backward 是最稳定的组件，可优先试用。
standard.avoidWhen: 调试训练问题时建议关闭所有 TurboCore 组件（回归到标准路径）。Windows 上 Triton 支持有限，kernel_autotune 效果可能不明显。

standard_en.summary: TurboCore is the Lulynx trainer's performance optimisation engine, combining several CUDA-kernel-level accelerations: fused backward, native update dispatch, kernel autotune and more.
standard_en.effect: fused_backward: merges several backward kernels, cutting kernel-launch overhead by roughly 15%~20% (from the gradient release manager); kernel_autotune: tunes CUDA kernel parameters automatically (measured at 1.14x); native_update_dispatch: optimises the weight update path.
standard_en.whenToUse: Every TurboCore component is off by default (experimental). Enable them one at a time, verifying stability before enabling more. fused_backward is the most stable component and the one to try first.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When debugging a training problem it is advisable to turn every TurboCore component off (back to the standard path). Triton support on Windows is limited, so kernel_autotune may show little effect.

advanced.principle: fused_backward 通过 GradientReleaseManager 将多个参数的 backward 合并（full 档：全量合并，compatible 档：分组合并），减少 CUDA kernel 发射次数。kernel_autotune 通过 NVRTC 生成变体 kernel，自动选择最快配置并缓存。native_update_dispatch 优化 LoRA 权重更新的 CUDA 调度路径。
advanced.tradeoffs: fused_backward 与某些优化器（如 Prodigy 的特殊 step 逻辑）可能不完全兼容（有 compatible 降级档）。kernel_autotune 首次运行需要额外时间（约 1~3 分钟）进行 profiling，之后缓存加速。

advanced_en.principle: fused_backward merges backwards of multiple parameters through GradientReleaseManager (full tier: merge everything; compatible tier: group merging), reducing CUDA kernel launch count. kernel_autotune generates variant kernels via NVRTC, automatically picking the fastest configuration and caching it. native_update_dispatch optimizes the CUDA dispatch path for LoRA weight updates.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: fused_backward may not be fully compatible with some optimizers (e.g. Prodigy's special step logic) — there is a compatible downgrade tier. kernel_autotune needs extra time on first run (about 1~3 minutes) for profiling, then the cache speeds it up.
